request: Add a Maintenance schedule: unit name, service interval in days, last service date and next due date, linked to the item it is for.

outcome.renderedDiff:
New record type "Maintenance schedule" with 4 fields:
  - Unit name (text, required)
  - Service interval (days) (whole number)
  - Last service date (date)
  - Next due date (date)
  Records are shared by all companies in this tenant.
  It gets its own menu entry "Maintenance schedule" with a list, a record page and a form.
  People who can use the rest of the application can create, change, archive and restore Maintenance schedule records.
New required link "Item" from Maintenance schedule to Item. Choose it when creating a record.

Stored data: a new table, 2 new indexes, addForeignKey. Nothing already stored is changed or removed.
Rolling back hides this change again and keeps every record entered under it.
